history.title: 巴黎博览会确立名称
history.desc: 国际现代装饰与工业艺术博览会在巴黎举办，装饰艺术由此得名并传播开来。
history.title_en: The Paris exposition names the style
history.desc_en: The Exposition internationale des arts décoratifs et industriels modernes in Paris gave the style its name and momentum.

history.title: 进入建筑与大众视觉
history.desc: 阶梯轮廓和几何纹样出现在摩天楼立面、剧院、海报和奢侈品中，成为现代奢华的代表语言。
history.desc_en: Stepped contours and geometric motifs appeared on skyscrapers, theaters, posters, and luxury goods, defining modern luxury.

history.title: 传播并产生地域变体
history.desc: 装饰艺术传播到世界各地，在上海、迈阿密、孟买等城市留下各自的地域变体。
history.desc_en: Art Deco spread worldwide, leaving distinct local variants in cities such as Shanghai, Miami, and Mumbai.

lessonPractice.title: 你让 AI 把精品酒店官网改成装饰艺术风格，结果页面只是换成了黑底金字，构图没有变化。哪个反馈最接近问题？

options.label: 要求先建立中轴对称骨架、阶梯轮廓和放射纹样，金色只作少量点缀
options.feedback: 装饰艺术的判断依据是几何骨架；对称、阶梯和放射关系成立后，材质才有附着点。

options.label: 认可当前方向，装饰艺术就是黑金配色，可以再加大金色面积
options.feedback: 黑金只是容易被记住的配色结果；没有对称和几何纹样时，加大金色面积也得不到装饰艺术。

options.label: 加入更多植物藤蔓和流动曲线，让页面看起来更复古
options.feedback: 长曲线和植物形态属于新艺术；装饰艺术使用对称的几何形，两种风格的形状语言相反。

en.title: You asked the AI to take a boutique hotel site in an Art Deco direction, and it only switched the page to a black background with gold text. Which response comes closest to the problem?

options.label: Ask for a symmetrical skeleton, stepped contours, and radiating motifs first, with gold only as a restrained accent
options.feedback: Art Deco is judged by its geometric skeleton; materials only have a place once symmetry, steps, and rays exist.

options.label: Approve the direction since Art Deco is the black-and-gold palette, then enlarge the gold areas
options.feedback: Black and gold is only the memorable surface result; without symmetry and geometric motifs, more gold is still not Art Deco.

options.label: Add more plant vines and flowing curves to make the page feel more vintage
options.feedback: Long curves and plant forms belong to Art Nouveau; Art Deco uses symmetrical geometry, the opposite shape language.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 把酒店首页改成装饰艺术方向：先建立中轴对称的骨架，主视觉用阶梯收分的轮廓和放射纹样，深底加一处金属金点缀就够了；纹样不要进入正文区域。改完后指出对称轴、阶梯和放射分别在哪儿，再用手机宽度检查标题没有溢出。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Take the hotel home page in an Art Deco direction: build a symmetrical skeleton first, use stepped contours and radiating motifs in the hero, and keep a dark base with a single metallic gold accent; motifs stay out of body text. Afterwards point out where the symmetry axis, steps, and rays are, then check at phone width that headlines do not overflow.

entry.prompt: 做一个精品酒店官网首页，装饰艺术方向：中轴对称的骨架，主视觉用阶梯收分的轮廓和放射纹样，深底加一处金属金点缀；纹样不进入正文区域，正文保持可读。酒店信息只用我提供的资料，缺的标“待补充”。
entry.prompt_en: Art Deco boutique hotel homepage, mirrored central symmetry, stepped ziggurat contours and sunburst motifs in the hero, dark base with one restrained metallic gold accent, motifs kept out of body text, elegant readable type

references.title: V&A：新艺术——一场国际风格
references.title_en: V&A: Art Nouveau – an international style

use.t: Boutique hotel, jewelry, and watch websites
Vintage theater, gala, and exhibition event pages
Craft-led luxury products such as perfume and whisky

dont.t: Turning headings and buttons gold while the skeleton stays unchanged
Using plant vines and long curves, which belong to Art Nouveau
Spreading motifs across body text until it becomes unreadable
Dropping misaligned elements into a symmetrical composition

principles.t: Build a mirrored skeleton around a central axis
Shape contours that step inward layer by layer
Use sunburst, fan, and zigzag geometric motifs
Create refinement with fine lines and repetition
Keep metallic sheen as a small-area accent

distinctions.label: Black-and-gold palette
distinctions.text: Black and gold is just a palette that any style can use; {c:style-art-deco} is judged by its skeleton of symmetry, stepped contours, and radiating motifs.

distinctions.label: Art Nouveau
distinctions.text: Art Nouveau uses plant-like long curves and organic forms; {c:style-art-deco} uses symmetrical geometry and straight or zigzag lines. They are close in era but opposite in shape language.
